OVSDB
item.description: APIs to build the virtual lab network topology.

item.name: Create bridge ovsbr-01 on node srv-01-01

request.description: Requests that the controller create bridge ovsbr-01 on node srv-01-01. The node is preconfigured to connect to the controller with ovs-vsctl set-manager 172.20.254.220:6640. In the URL, %2F represents "/".

item.name: Delete switching flow from OpenFlow node openflow:x

item.name: Delete LLDP forwarding flow from OpenFlow node openflow:x

request.description: Removes the example LLDP forwarding flow from the selected OpenFlow node.
